pdf_metadata.title: Microsoft Word - 170.315_b__10_ Electronic Health Information Export  Documentation.doc
pdf_metadata.author: e

export_components.name: Documents
export_components.description: CDA XML DOC Export file containing the 'Documents' folder containing patient's supporting documents or attachments when available.

export_components.name: Notes
export_components.description: CDA XML DOC Export file folder containing all the notes recorded during the patient's previous medical visits/encounters.

export_components.name: BillingReport
export_components.description: CSV file containing the patient's financial transactions with their provider. The information includes the patient information, transaction dates, charges, claims and the description of transactions made with status.

export_components.name: CCDA
export_components.description: XML file export of a patient's clinical data. The system allows exports of HL7 CCDA which complies with United States Core Data for Interoperability (USCDI), Version 1 requirements. The specifications for the CCDA can be obtained from the HL7 website.

export_components.name: demographics
export_components.description: CSV file that contains the patient's key information, identification details, contact information, insurance information etc.

export_components.name: PatientDocumentFiles
export_components.description: CSV mapping file that contains the list of patient's documents. This file outlines the contents of the patient's supporting attachments contained in the 'Documents' folder.

export_components.name: Schedule
export_components.description: CSV file that contains a record of the patient's encounters with specific information including appointment date, provider, location, appointment type, workflow, notes and date on which notes are recorded.
field_names: date on which notes are recorded

export_components.name: Chart Documents
export_components.description: Optionally included via [Include Chart Documents] checkbox. Contains chart documents with optional sticky notes on TIF documents.

export_components.name: Custom Patient Data Tables
export_components.description: Custom (user-created) Patient Data Tables are included as part of the CDA whenever the export is done using the Batch CDA option, unless the custom Patient Data Table is set to be excluded as FHR.

issues.detail: Found 2 truncated sentence(s) ending with 'For additional details on the export format and default paths,' — references a document not provided.
Both v1.0 and v2.0 are described as 'Original Document' (2 entries).
Documentation lacks: field/column names for CSV files, data types, value sets or code sets, relationships between files, sample data files, machine-readable schemas, screenshots of the export UI

summary_statistics.note: No field-level documentation exists. The PDF describes file components at a high level (file name, format, 1-2 sentence description) but does not document individual columns/fields within CSV files or CDA sections.
